verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS payments platform that ships Web and React Native SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out for MoonPay's widget, SDKs, API or MCP server. Related controls such as clearing a browser connection or deleting a stored card are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
